recognize_zh: 高倍鐵染色（Prussian blue）下，數顆紅血球系前驅細胞的細胞核外圍被一圈藍黑色鐵顆粒環繞，形成典型的環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）；這是 MDS 伴環狀鐵粒母細胞與 MDS/MPN-RS-T 的診斷關鍵。
features: Erythroid precursors with coarse blue-black iron granules forming a complete or near-complete perinuclear ring
Granules number well over five and encircle more than one-third of the nucleus
Other precursors with fewer, partially perinuclear granules
Pink counterstained nuclei and cytoplasm in background
describe_en: Prussian blue iron stain of the bone marrow aspirate at high power shows several erythroid precursors with numerous coarse siderotic granules arranged in a ring around the nucleus. These meet the criteria for ring sideroblasts (at least 5 granules encircling at least one-third of the nuclear circumference). Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts, which in a clonal context support myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts or MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts have only 1-4 fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm rather than a perinuclear ring.
Ring sideroblasts are morphologically identical; congenital onset, microcytosis and lack of SF3B1 mutation distinguish it.

ddx.dx: Reversible sideroblastic anemia (copper deficiency, zinc excess, alcohol, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts look the same; causes are identified by history and resolve after correction, often with cytoplasmic vacuolization of precursors.
